slice: Generated exact-layout viewport and compound INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND ownership

sources.project: Open Design Alliance DWG specification v5.4.1
sources.observation: The DWG VIEWPORT entity section specifies geometry/view fields and common handles but does not list DXF group 69 vpID. VIEWPORT ENTITY CONTROL type 70 and VIEWPORT ENTITY HEADER type 71 are separate objects.
sources.disposition: Do not assert DXF vpID values in DWG entity tests. Compare DWG viewport entity handles, owners, LAYOUT last-active references, and R2004+ count/list. Keep ID 1/2 profiles in DXF-only tests.

sources.observation: The DWG parse/encode functions do not read/write vpID; DXF parse/write does. A generated AC1015 experiment emitted type-34 viewport frames that the local reader reported as failed entities; AC1024 exposed viewport entities but not DXF vpID values.
sources.disposition: AC1015 warning remains an unresolved writer-vs-reader boundary pending direct chain/handle-stream and independent parser inspection. Do not attribute cause or promote support from this same-codec experiment.

implementation.summary: Extended the generated DWG test with separate line/text markers in two paper-layout owners, two AC1024 viewport entities per layout with exact LAYOUT references, a distinct ordinary block, and a ModelSpace INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND chain. AC1015 uses the legacy chain line/text case without viewport entities while the type-34 warning remains unresolved.

remaining: Direct AC1015 entity-chain and type-34 viewport frame inspection
Direct AC1024 BLOCK_HEADER owned-list byte-stream inspection
Active/current layout selection and non-default current layout
One composed exact-pinned independent structural/native qualification
limitations: The generated same-codec roundtrip is fast internal evidence, not independent acceptance. No external sample, persistent fixture, peer, or native CAD application was used. The source/test worktree remains broadly dirty from prior implementation; changes were not committed or broadly staged.
